scope: targeted local test phase; no remote CI execution
notes: Threshold probes use controlled input documents and execute the unmodified CLI. They are not measurements of elapsed CI time.
The fresh serial artifact was generated by a one-script filtered lane using the real runner. Its Orca test uses a fake backend; no live Orca claim is made.
Held-out scoring replays downloaded historical artifacts; it is not a new performance measurement.
Hosted CI, artifact download/upload actions, and the complete suite remain outside this phase.
